description: Append a new revision of an existing journal note, retaining the previous revisions. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

body.description: Journal note text, 1-6000 characters; no credentials.

book_id.description: 32 lowercase hex paper-account ID from an owned account result.

entry_id.description: Existing journal entry ID: 32 lowercase hex characters, copied from the journal.

event_id.description: Optional paper event ID from this version; omit for an unlinked note.

expected_revision.description: Current integer revision returned by the journal; rejects stale revisions.

kind.description: Journal note category: hypothesis, observation, decision or review.

version_id.description: Exact version_id belonging to this paper account, copied from its read result.

name: research_paper_revise_journal
title: Revise Paper Journal
